steps.title: Read Earth's offer
steps.body: Type `enable`, then `dir flash:` to list the files, and `more flash:earth-offer.txt` to read the offer. Name each service model with `submit A=IaaS` style answers, and the deployment model with `submit D=...`.

steps.title: Route the Grid into the cloud
steps.body: Run `show ip route`: the tunnel network 172.31.0.0/30 is there, the cloud network 10.200.0.0/16 is not. Earth's end of the tunnel is 172.31.0.2. Go to `configure terminal` and add `ip route 10.200.0.0 255.255.0.0 172.31.0.2`. Then `end` and `ping 10.200.1.10`.

objectives.label: The cloud server 10.200.1.10 answers a ping

steps.title: Settle who patches what
steps.body: Read `more flash:shared-responsibility.txt` and answer Volt's two questions with `submit OS=...` and `submit DATA=...`.

objectives.label: Who patches the OS in IaaS
Who protects the data in SaaS
